findings.title: references/testing.md 未说明 cookie 写请求需要 trustedOrigins 与 Origin 头
findings.detail: testing.md 的整应用测试示例只发起 GET，未提及写请求；而 authentication 的 checkCookieWriteOrigin 会对 cookie 认证的非 GET/HEAD/OPTIONS 请求校验 origin/referer 是否可信，缺失即返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。Agent 按文档写出 POST 测试后会先失败。
findings.impact: Agent 需要反复试错并回读 authentication 源码才能让写接口测试通过，增加接入时间与错误率。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 testing.md 的示例后补充：写请求需在 createAppTest 的 config.auth 中设置 trustedOrigins 并携带匹配的 Origin 头（或说明 TestSession.fetch 的行为）。

diagnosis.trigger: 按 testing.md 示例编写 cookie 认证的 POST/PATCH 集成测试
diagnosis.expected: 文档给出可完成写请求的最小配置（trustedOrigins + Origin）
diagnosis.actual: 文档仅展示 GET；写请求返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN，需从 auth.js 源码推断
diagnosis.workaround: 应用中配置 config.auth.trustedOrigins 并为写请求手动加 Origin 头
diagnosis.acceptance: testing.md 含一个通过写请求的示例，照抄即可 200

feedbackReview.reason: testing.md 的整应用测试小节只给出 GET 示例，全文无 Origin/trustedOrigins 说明（grep 无命中）；而 auth.js 的 checkCookieWriteOrigin 对带 cookie 的非 GET/HEAD/OPTIONS 请求在缺少可信 origin 时返回 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN，探针日志 E59 在同一 helper 上实测 POST/PATCH 403、GET 200。应用只能自配 trustedOrigins 并手动补 Origin 头（E34/E60）。属文档 guidance-gap，非运行时缺陷主张。

checks.reason: testing.md 承诺用 createAppTest + signIn 走真实登录测试整应用路由鉴权，示例只发 GET，未说明写请求所需的 Origin/trustedOrigins；helper 文档语义是'以已登录用户身份请求'。
auth.js 的 checkCookieWriteOrigin 对 cookie 认证的非 GET/HEAD/OPTIONS 请求在 source 缺失或不信任时返回 invalidCsrfOrigin；E59 记录同一会话 POST/PATCH 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN、GET 200。
应用未误用 API，而是显式配置 config.auth.trustedOrigins 并在写请求补 Origin 头（E34），且把该要求写进 server/AGENTS.md（E60），说明现有文档未覆盖。
现象在 createTestApp 启动的真实应用与测试数据库上复现（E21/E59），非外部服务、凭据或依赖缺失所致；403 由本应用认证中间件返回。
该文档属模板自带的 nocobase-app-development Skill（E24），未见工厂提示或 QA/构建脚本改写其内容；无工厂材料可解释该缺口。
现有公开路径只有 testing.md 的整应用测试指引与 signIn helper，二者都不发送 Origin、也未提供写请求配置；cli.md 的 origin 指引针对部署 publicOrigin，不覆盖测试 CSRF。

findings.title: signIn 的 TestSession.fetch 只带 cookie，不发送已定义的 TEST_ORIGIN
findings.detail: testing.js 中 TEST_ORIGIN='http://localhost' 已知且用于拼 apiRoot，但 TestSession.fetch 只设置 cookie 头，不设置 Origin。写请求因此无法满足 checkCookieWriteOrigin，除非应用另行信任并手动加头。
findings.impact: 公开的登录测试 helper 对写请求开箱不可用，违背 helper 的直觉用途。
findings.suggestedChange: 让 TestSession.fetch 默认发送 Origin: TEST_ORIGIN（或在文档中明确其不适用于写请求并给出替代）。

diagnosis.trigger: 使用 signIn(...).fetch 发起 cookie 认证的写请求
diagnosis.expected: 签名会话可直接完成写请求
diagnosis.actual: fetch 不带 Origin，服务端 CSRF 校验拒绝
diagnosis.workaround: 调用方在 fetch 的 headers 里自补 Origin，并在应用配置 trustedOrigins
diagnosis.acceptance: 不改调用方请求头即可用会话完成写请求，或文档明确不支持

feedbackReview.reason: signIn 返回的 TestSession.fetch 只合并 cookie 头，TEST_ORIGIN 仅用于拼 apiRoot，从不作为请求头；服务端 checkCookieWriteOrigin 要求可信 source，因此该公开 helper 的写请求必然 403（E59 实测）。可改 helper 或补文档，属可用性改进。

checks.reason: testing.js 公开 signIn/TestSession.fetch，文档把它作为以已登录用户身份发起请求的入口；契约包含'携带会话 cookie 调用 fetch'，但未声明写请求需额外头。
E22 显示 fetch 只写 cookie 头且 TEST_ORIGIN 未用于请求；E23 服务端在缺可信 origin 时拒绝；E59 实测 POST/PATCH 403、GET 200。
应用通过调用方补 Origin 头并配置 trustedOrigins 绕行（E34/E60），未修改 helper；是 helper 能力边界而非应用误用。
在真实应用+测试数据库环境复现（E21/E59），排除外部服务、凭据或安装问题。
helper 是插件包内公开源码（E22），无工厂提示或脚本介入；缺口源于 helper 自身实现。
fetch 没有 origin 参数或默认头，文档也未说明限制或替代，现有公开能力不足以开箱完成写请求。

findings.title: nocobase-db Skill 的 seed 示例与该仓库基线 ESLint 规则冲突
findings.detail: SKILL.md 的 seed 示例把 repository 解构为独立方法再调用，与该仓库默认 lint 规则冲突；Agent 照抄会在提交前被 ESLint 拦下。
findings.impact: 增加一次无谓的写错-修正循环，并可能让 Agent 误以为 @nocobase/db 用法有误。
findings.suggestedChange: 示例改为 async run(context) { const repository = context.repository; ... } 或直接 context.repository('orderStatuses').upsertOne(...)，并在 troubleshooting 表补充该 lint 提示。
findings.claimed: Skill 示例：async run({ repository }) { await repository('orderStatuses').upsertOne({...}) }
findings.observed: 同一解构写法触发默认 @typescript-eslint/unbound-method（数据库方法丢失 this），应用改为 async run(context) { context.repository('todos') } 后才通过 lint。

diagnosis.trigger: 照 Skill seed 示例编写并运行默认 ESLint
diagnosis.expected: 示例代码通过仓库基线 lint
diagnosis.workaround: 改用 run(context) 并把 repository 作为对象方法调用
diagnosis.acceptance: Skill 示例原样通过 ESLint

feedbackReview.reason: nocobase-db SKILL.md 的 seed 示例解构 run({ repository }) 后调用 repository('orderStatuses').upsertOne（E12），而应用基线 lint 通过 @nocobase/dev-config/eslint 的 recommendedTypeChecked 启用 @typescript-eslint/unbound-method（E63），E58 记录实际报错于该 seed 写法；应用改用 run(context) + context.repository('todos')（E31）才通过。属 guidance-gap。

checks.reason: SKILL.md 的 seed/migration 示例是要求照抄的规范代码；示例用 run({ repository }) 解构并直接调用 repository(...)，文档未提示该写法与 lint 的冲突（E12）；默认 lint 链启用 unbound-method（E63）。
默认 typescript 配置展开 recommendedTypeChecked，包含 unbound-method（E63）；E58 记录 eslint 对该 seed 模式报 unbound-method，属实际运行观察。
应用的可用 seed 用 run(context) 并把 repository 作为 context 方法调用（E31），即必须偏离 Skill 示例才能通过。
该规则来自已安装的 @nocobase/dev-config/eslint（E63）并由 app/eslint.config.js 引入，E58 在同一环境触发；非环境偶发。
工厂配置附加在应用配置之后，但 E58 证明实际 lint 确实报错，说明没有工厂覆盖消除该问题；冲突写法在 Skill 源文件 E12。
Skill 的 troubleshooting / 'API shapes that do not exist' 只纠正 db.repository() 缺名等，不涉及解构丢失 this 的 lint 冲突；现有指引无法让示例原样通过。

findings.title: Scheduler 插件不提供管理页面，每个应用都要自建计划与运行记录页
findings.detail: operations.md 明确插件不贡献页面，只有 HTTP API 与 sync 命令；本应用因此新增 client/pages/scheduler/* 才能满足 B01–B03 的人工验收路径。
findings.impact: 常见的管理需求需要在每个应用重复实现列表/启用停用/运行记录视图，拉长交付并引入不一致。
findings.suggestedChange: 提供一个可选的、位于 scheduler.schedules 权限下的管理页面（或作为模板示例），插件仍可保持无页面为默认。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用需要在界面上管理计划与运行记录
diagnosis.expected: 插件或模板提供可复用的管理视图
diagnosis.actual: 插件无页面，应用自建 client/pages/scheduler/*
diagnosis.workaround: 复制本应用的实现或按 operations.md 的 API 自建
diagnosis.acceptance: 新应用无需自写页面即可完成列表/启停/查看运行记录

feedbackReview.reason: operations.md 明确插件不贡献页面，只提供 HTTP 路由与 schedulerServiceToken（E6/E3）；插件 client 入口只注册 locales、注释亦声明 no pages（E64）。本应用为此自建 client/pages/scheduler/* 路由（E33），QA 报告 B01–B03 才通过（E35）。属可复用的插件能力改进建议。

evidence.excerpt:
Use the installed version's public exports, without importing plugin internals. The application owns business logic, schedule declarations, Providers, permissions, and deployment timing. Scheduler owns scheduling projections, trigger history, and execution state. The plugin's `skills/` directory is the source of truth; do not edit the synchronized application copy under `.agents/skills/`.

## Decide Whether to Use Scheduler

The primary reason to define tasks through Scheduler is **UI observability for business administrators**. Developers define schedules and execution logic in code. Business administrators use the task list and detail pages the application builds on the Scheduler API to view schedules, track individual executions, and enable or disable tasks when authorized.

Tasks that do not need to be viewed and tracked through the UI must not be managed by the Scheduler plugin. Give recurring ones a `ScheduleExecutor` of their own from the application's jobs service (`jobExecutorServiceToken` in `@nocobase/app-server/jobs`), and one-off background work a `JobExecutor`; the application development Skill describes both. For administrator-visible tasks, deliver Client registration, access permissions, meaningful task names, and accurate final execution status together; successful server-side dispatch alone is incomplete.

## Then Choose the Execution Model

After deciding to use Scheduler, choose according to business complexity:

| Scenario                                                                                  | Choice          | Implementation boundary                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Periodic cleanup, cache refresh, a single report, or one business Service call            | Own target type | Short operations may complete directly; hand lengthy work to a `JobExecutor`                             |
| A simple operation that happens hourly                                                    | Own target type | Cron alone is not a reason to introduce a heavier execution system                                       |
| Immediate asynchronous execution                                                          | `JobExecutor`   | No Cron Schedule is needed                                                                               |
| A one-time delay, such as ten minutes after a request                                     | Queue `delay`   | No Cron Schedule is needed; `JobExecutor` has no delay                                                   |
| Another execution system with its own references, status queries, and completion protocol | Own target type | The same `registerTarget()` call, with `inspect()` and completion reporting for work that finishes later |

Every schedule points at a registered target; `registerTarget()` is the target extension surface, and there is no built-in target type. A target does not guarantee exactly-once external business effects; design business idempotency.

evidence.excerpt:
### Declaring a route

Every hand-written `/api` route declares itself with `describeRoute()` from `@nocobase/app-server/router`, as in the example above, after its authentication and permission middleware and before its `apiValidator()`s. A route that declares nothing is a defect the API check reports by name.

- **`tags`**: the plugin name in PascalCase, such as `Scheduler`, `Users` or `Agents`. The application's own routes tag the resource, such as `Orders`.
- **`summary`**: an English verb phrase, such as `Enable a Schedule`.
- **`operationId`**: the namespace, a verb and the resource in camelCase, unique across the application, such as `schedulerListOccurrences`; the application's own routes have no namespace, `cancelOrder`.
- **`description`**: what a caller cannot read from the schemas, such as the permission a route requires or which credential it expects. A credential that is not one of the document's security schemes is described here and only here.
- **Inputs**: `apiValidator()` for every path, query, header and JSON input, which documents the parameters and the body.
- **Responses**: `dataResponse(schema)` for `{ data }`, `listResponse(itemSchema, metaSchema?)` for `{ data, meta }`, `emptyResponse()` for a `204`, and the standard error body through `apiErrorResponse(status)` or `apiErrorResponse(409, 'When …')`. Do not list `400` for input validation: a route that uses `apiValidator` gets the `400` automatically. List `400` yourself only for another reason, such as a failed precondition. `apiErrorResponses` is `401`, `403` and `500`, for an authenticated route with a permission check; otherwise list each status the route can return with `apiErrorResponse(code)`.
- **Security**: a route a caller reaches without a credential, such as a status probe or the locales the sign-in page reads, declares `security: []`. Every other route inherits the document's top-level requirement, a session cookie (`cookieAuth`) or an API key in `x-api-key` (`apiKeyAuth`), which the authentication and API keys plugins contribute.
- **Schemas** live in the plugin's `server/routes/schemas.ts`. A schema several routes share carries `.meta({ ref: '<PluginName><Thing>' })`, such as `SchedulerSchedule`, and becomes a named component; public fields carry `.meta({ description })`, which stays next to the `$ref` when the field's schema is a shared one. A response object is documented open, so adding a field later is not a breaking change, unless its schema is `z.strictObject()`; a JSON body validated with `z.strictObject()` is documented closed. Recursive schemas such as `z.json()` need no workaround: they become components, named by their `ref` when they declare one.

# Server routes

HTTP endpoints live in `server/routes/` and are listed in the array `server/routes/index.ts` exports, which `server/runtime.ts` passes to the application.

## Two kinds

| Function             | Path in code     | Final URL        | For                                              |
| -------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `defineApiRoutes()`  | `/orders`        | `/api/orders`    | Application APIs the browser calls               |
| `defineRootRoutes()` | `/callbacks/pay` | `/callbacks/pay` | Webhooks, OAuth callbacks, protocol entry points |

Do not repeat `/api` in the path, and never write the deployment base path such as `/main` — both are added by the runtime.

Name paths, shape responses and errors, validate input and declare each route for the API document as [HTTP API design](http-api.md) describes. Every `/api` route carries a `describeRoute()` and validates its input with `apiValidator()`, both from `@nocobase/app-server/router`; a route without a declaration is a defect.

evidence.excerpt: - **Verify the browser-facing origin before handing over a running application.** Set `app.publicOrigin` to the protocol, host and port the user actually opens, without the application's base path. On a remote development machine, inspect its LAN address or use the established domain instead of assuming `localhost`. An explicit `APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` overrides the file, including values in `.env` and `.env.local`; `pnpm dev` must not supply a fallback that overrides the configured origin. Verify an authentication request with the intended browser Origin as well as the page and health endpoint: those two GET requests alone cannot reveal a rejected login origin. `403 INVALID_ORIGIN` means the access address is not trusted; correct the origin configuration rather than disabling origin checks or trusting every host.
